accessibility.title: Staged worker-uplift observability activation flow
accessibility.description: The diagram shows the live pre-freeze five-synthetic baseline, failed older cutover, completed rollback to stable generation 5 shadow, quarantined candidate, active mutation freeze, conflicting PR #471, private metrics and ownership gates, accepted standing-major forecast, deferred signals, and retained evidence required before activation.

review_notes: The generated_at and generator fields record the original 2026-07-28 artifact generation; the 2026-08-01 rollout-state and cutover-safety reconciliation was manual and does not constitute regeneration or approval.

Reconcile conflicting backend PR #471 with PR #483, authoritative generation 5 ownership, the separate exact-eight runtime-container recreation requirement, the quarantined failed candidate, and retained incident evidence before a fresh qualification or deployment.
Keep worker merges, backend mutations, replay, reconciliation, Grafana apply, synthetics, Runtime 1/fetcher v2, and web merge frozen until source hardening and incident reconciliation complete.
Reconcile the companion infra policy JSON's old package source, approved status, exact buckets, health/value allowlists, and break-glass semantics before apply.
Verify the complete histogram bucket set, bounded health checks, lease safety, and lifecycle outcomes against the final worker image revisions.

Retain evidence that the live five-check, two-probe, 300-second topology projects 86,400 monthly executions and that the protected standing-major acknowledgment was verified true; keep the warning and 90,000 ceiling.
Confirm the four read-only Synthetic Monitoring Environment inputs and every production writer/reviewer prerequisite without publishing values.
Require deployed scrape, Loki label-boundary, quota, SLO, and firing/recovery evidence before changing staged wording to live.
